messages:
status-bot: [ALERT] eu-west1 apiserver 5xx and attach timeouts increasing :warning:
sam.sre: seeing apiserver p99 jump and controller-manager reconcile backlog. Several GPU pods stuck ContainerCreating with AttachVolume errors
violet.infra: looking at nat-cgw-eu-1 metrics-> SNAT port usage 96%, conntrack near max on gw-1
hamid.eng: recent onboarding job ran parallel model fetch across 120 pods — each opened ~2k outbound connections briefly
sam.sre: that explains it. short-lived outbound spike causing SNAT exhaustion and apiserver requests to time out
oncall-sre: immediate actions?
violet.infra: plan: spin up nat-cgw-eu-4, shift 25% of subnets, bump nf_conntrack_max on gw-1 as stopgap
hamid.eng: I'll patch onboarding to add per-pod concurrency limit (throttle model prefetch) and stagger starts
status-bot: infra deploy triggered: terraform apply plan-2026-03-22-nat-add
violet.infra: created nat-cgw-eu-4, migrating subnets in small batches now
sam.sre: monitoring: after re-route apiserver latency p99 down from 1.2s -> 310ms, attach timeouts decreasing
oncall-sre: scaled kube-apiserver to 4 replicas while infra shifts traffic to reduce retry amplification
hamid.eng: pushed a hotfix to onboarding: concurrency cap 8, randomized jitter between starts
violet.infra: conntrack dropping from ~240k -> 140k after move, SNAT ports freed :thumbsup:
status-bot: incident mitigated. ticket INC-2026-421 created
sam.sre: postmortem items: - why conntrack autoscale didn't fire earlier - add egress shaping for large onboarding jobs - add synthetic test for heavy egress during attach - evaluate per-customer egress isolation vs larger NAT pool
hamid.eng: will add regression test and backoff in next rollout
oncall-sre: leaving runbook notes in ops-runbooks/nat-exhaustion.md, assigning follow-ups
sam.sre: closing thread as mitigated but keeping notes for postmortem :white_check_mark:
